verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents pay-per-token serverless access to 'the most popular OSS models' and 'leading open-source text models' through OpenAI-compatible APIs, and claims 100+ supported models. However, no evidence names the specific families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS) on serverless, and the docs note on-demand offers 'a wider selection of models than serverless', so the serverless catalog's breadth is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit serverless model list naming Llama/Qwen/DeepSeek/GPT-OSS families, evidence of which of the 100+ models are on shared serverless versus dedicated only, independent corroboration of catalog breadth and currency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among a broad catalog of current open-weight model families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS and peers) on shared serverless endpoints

citations.quote: Get instant access to the most popular OSS models, optimized for cost, speed, and quality.
Use popular models instantly with pay-per-token pricing.
Fireworks provides fast, cost-effective access to leading open-source text models through OpenAI-compatible APIs.
100+ Supported Models - Text, vision, audio, image, and embeddings
You point your client at `api.fireworks.ai`, send tokens, and pay only for what you use — no GPUs to size, no autoscaler to tune, no cold starts to wait through.
